title: Cape Town vs Marrakech: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Cape Town for world-class scenery, nature, and English infrastructure. Marrakech for cultural immersion, budget value, and the ancient medina experience. Two completely different African cities for two very different travelers.

categories.name: Daily Budget
categories.summary: Marrakech runs $40-70/day. Cape Town runs $70-120/day. Factor in flights and Marrakech is dramatically cheaper for European travelers.

categories.name: Scenery & Setting
categories.summary: Table Mountain + Atlantic Ocean = one of Earth's most spectacular city settings.

categories.name: Cultural Immersion
categories.summary: The ancient medina, souks, and Jemaa el-Fna are a living city unlike anything in the Western world.

categories.name: Food Scene
categories.summary: Cape Town for fine dining innovation; Marrakech for traditional Moroccan authenticity and value.

categories.name: Beaches
categories.summary: Camps Bay and Clifton are stunning. Marrakech has no nearby beaches.

categories.name: Nature & Outdoors
categories.summary: Table Mountain, Cape Peninsula, penguins, whale watching, shark diving — Cape Town is a nature paradise.

categories.name: Safety
categories.summary: Different risks: Cape Town has higher-stakes crime; Marrakech has lower-stakes scams and touts.

categories.name: Getting There
categories.summary: 3-4h from Europe on budget carriers. Cape Town is 11-16h and much more expensive.

categories.name: Language
categories.summary: English everywhere in Cape Town. Marrakech uses Darija Arabic and French.

categories.name: Day Trips
categories.summary: Cape Town: Peninsula, Winelands, whale watching. Marrakech: Atlas Mountains, Sahara, Essaouira.

faq.question: Is Cape Town or Marrakech better for first-time Africa visitors?
faq.answer: Cape Town is easier — English everywhere, Uber, world-class infrastructure. Marrakech is more culturally immersive and dramatically cheaper. Pick based on whether you want comfort + scenery (Cape Town) or cultural challenge + value (Marrakech).

faq.question: Which is cheaper, Cape Town or Marrakech?
faq.answer: Marrakech is significantly cheaper on the ground ($40-70/day vs $70-120/day) and far cheaper to reach from Europe (3-4h budget flight vs 11-12h expensive long-haul).

faq.question: What is the best time to visit Cape Town vs Marrakech?
faq.answer: Cape Town: Sep-Apr (Southern summer). Marrakech: Oct-Apr (avoid Jun-Aug: 38-44C). Best overlap: March-April or October-November.
